verdicts.reason: Both leave the patterned background as a strip across the middle, with empty white bands roughly 20% tall above and below, so neither fills the 768×432 canvas or rearranges the design for it. A is a straight shrink: the dark panel and the gold headline are small and thin, so the headline reads weakly. B enlarges the panel so the headline is legible and clearly the focal point, but the panel nearly touches the top and bottom of the strip and covers most of the brand pattern, which makes it look cramped and loses some of the original's character.
